lede: The biggest thing on the board this week is a special meeting at Telluride Medical Center where trustees will take up a proposal to engage Jensen Partners for due diligence with CommonSpirit Health — one of the largest nonprofit hospital systems in the country — a step that could signal a major shift in how this valley gets its healthcare. The Ecology Commission is also moving on a draft ordinance that would ban gas-powered lawn and garden equipment in town limits by 2028–2030, and the Norwood Board of Trustees digs into its 2027 draft budget. On the lighter side, Warren Miller's 'Days Off' hits town Wednesday and Art Walk returns Friday.

notable.stake: Trustees vote on hiring due-diligence help for a potential CommonSpirit Health partnership.
